t: This is Carlos Place, a street and small urban square in the City of Westminster. It takes its name from Carlos the First of Portugal, who was king from 1889 until 1908. He was known as the Diplomat, and also as the Oceanographer, among many other names. His reign ended with his assassination, which made him the first Portuguese king to die violently since King Sebastian in 1578. He remains the only Portuguese king to have been assassinated.
